clay.delta: CACC-G12 becomes the continuity layer inside SCRF. C8 adds explicit memory lifecycles, an operation/device-aware Cognitive Resource Governor and a separate anti-attractor Salience Governor. Utility remains salience-only; exact target-Qwen continuity remains the promotion bottleneck.
clay.next_experiment: Exact-Qwen FIELD x MEMORY_PATH x SYSTEM_WS x INTERNAL_WS x REENTRY x RAIL factorial plus target trace resource-governor comparison.

frank.delta: C8 SCRF supersedes C7 only as the newest OPEN FRANK architecture candidate; C7 CORF remains its physical/runtime-boundary parent. Add memory lifecycle typing, anti-attractor salience control, cognitive resource allocation, nested internal-workspace receipts and causal rail audits.
frank.next_experiment: Shadow C8 against C7 with stage receipts, target-Qwen mediation, recovery and authority attack gates.

gwt.delta: R5 Nested Workspace Bridge becomes a first-class FRANK instrumentation stage. System WorkspaceEpisode, reader projection and model-internal uptake are distinct; internal uptake receipt is scientific evidence only and never authority.
gwt.next_experiment: EXP-LIVE-GWT-NESTED-QWEN using Jacobian Lens or equivalent on exact target reader, including truthful/shuffled re-entry rescue.

emergenz.delta: SCRF exposes better causal receipts for E-CERT2 but makes no emergence promotion. Resource routing, salience stability and internal-workspace mediation are candidate mechanisms/confounds that must be stage-orthogonally controlled.
emergenz.next_experiment: Prospective E-CERT2 only after exact-Qwen CACC effect survives shuffled, poisoned and resource-matched controls.

claycode.delta: CC-RC1.7 TCQS is embedded in query, Assembly and reader identities. C8 adds CausalCommunicationReceipt so P1/P2/P3/hybrid are audited by message presence/identity/content interventions, not compression alone.
claycode.next_experiment: TCQS cross-engine equivalence plus target reader P1/P2/P3 causal communication audit.

hyperposition.delta: HYP-RC4 firebreaks remain C8 authority semantics. SCRF makes coupling control explicit in salience/resource governors: n-ary representation may be rich while propagation gain/depth/budget remain bounded and independently tunable.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Higher-order representation x propagation-control factorial with UNKNOWN closure and authority-cast attacks.

claygraph.delta: G1d remains SCRF's preferred OPEN associative substrate. C8 adds explicit L3 associative-derived, L4 salience and L5 Assembly lifecycles plus anti-attractor controls. The local regime-shift calibration demonstrates a failure shape, not a live effect size.
claygraph.next_experiment: Frozen vs naive-adaptive vs guarded-adaptive field under role/temporal shifts, reward poisoning, useful-habit retention and target-Qwen task utility.

unifieddb.delta: U2 live results strengthen C8's logical-over-physical stance while quantifying trade-offs: same-process logical separate reads nearly matched monolith; JSON boundaries cost more; monolith writes were faster than canonical+outbox; selection integrity requires authenticated selector structure; per-operation freshness remains preferable to fictitious universal consistency if safety obligations are explicit.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Target FRANK trace replay across same-process logical, physically colocated and service-separated placements with recovery, selection and freshness receipts.

ancestry_note: Branch agreement is not counted as independent replication where it shares Clay/CACC/Fusion/FRANK ancestry.
